verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is Svelte's official meta-framework, documented under svelte.dev/docs/kit and compared directly to Next and Nuxt. It provides file-based routing via src/routes with server rendering, and lets you mix SSR, SSG and SPA rendering per page. Hands-on community users confirm its server/client load ordering and form actions for data fetching. Missing for 10: first-party docs in the pack describing the data-loading (load function) API, since data fetching is evidenced mainly by community reports.
